A.name: Contain on Bone
A.use: wide shots, scenes, or when a blur behind the dog reads busy

B.name: Blur-Fill
B.use: the default for any single-dog portrait OG photo

C.name: Editorial Split
C.use: a "meet the puppy" moment: photo beside a steel caption panel

D.name: Portrait Frame
D.use: a matted 3:4 portrait inside the 16:9 box

E.name: Top-Anchored Cover
E.use: a photo that should fill the box; the head is never cut, paws may crop

H.name: Duo Strip
H.use: two puppies or a pair, two portraits side by side

IG-1.name: Stat Panel
IG-1.use: cost, price, how much, how many (location, comparison, blog)

IG-2.name: Process Steps
IG-2.use: how to, steps, what happens, timeline (location, blog)

IG-3.name: Comparison Split
IG-3.use: versus, difference, which is better (comparison, blog)

IG-4.name: Checklist Grid
IG-4.use: checklist, what to check, what to bring, signs of (blog, comparison, location)
